description: This file implements a data structure (subs_vector_t) to manage a collection of subscription entries (subs_t). It includes functions for initializing, adding, removing, destroying, and garbage collecting subscriptions within the vector, as well as retrieving subscriptions by instance and dumping the vector's contents. The code is primarily focused on managing subscription data in memory, including dynamic memory handling for subscription properties.

methods.name: void SUBS_VECTOR_Init(subs_vector_t * suv)
methods.description: Initializes a subscription vector structure by setting its vector pointer to NULL and entry count to zero.

methods.name: void SUBS_VECTOR_Add(subs_vector_t * suv,subs_t * sub)
methods.description: Adds a new subscription to the vector, reallocating memory as needed and copying the subscription data.

methods.name: void SUBS_VECTOR_Remove(subs_vector_t * suv,subs_t * sub)
methods.description: Marks a subscription for deletion and removes it from the vector via garbage collection.

methods.name: void SUBS_VECTOR_Destroy(subs_vector_t * suv)
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with the subscription vector and resets it.

methods.name: void SUBS_VECTOR_DestroySubscriber(subs_t * sub)
methods.description: Frees all dynamically allocated memory within a subscription entry.

methods.name: subs_t * SUBS_VECTOR_GetSubsByInstance(subs_vector_t * suv,int instance)
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription by its instance number.

methods.name: void SUBS_VECTOR_MarkSubscriptionForDeletion(subs_t * sub)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a subscription and marks it as invalid for deletion.

methods.name: void SUBS_VECTOR_GarbageCollectSubscriptions(subs_vector_t * suv)
methods.description: Removes subscriptions marked invalid from the vector, compacting remaining entries.

methods.name: void SUBS_VECTOR_Dump(subs_vector_t * suv)
methods.description: Logs the contents of the subscription vector for debugging purposes.
